declarations.type:
∀ (first second third : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.VotingWeight),
  ∃ median,
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinResilientAuthorityMedian.MedianOfThree first second third median
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinResilientAuthorityMedian.median_order_exists

declarations.type:
∀
  (actualFaultWeight liveUpperBound first second third median :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.VotingWeight),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinResilientAuthorityMedian.MedianOfThree first second third median →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinResilientAuthorityMedian.AtLeastTwoHonestBounds actualFaultWeight
        liveUpperBound first second third →
      actualFaultWeight ≤ median ∧ median ≤ liveUpperBound
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinResilientAuthorityMedian.resilient_median_is_safe_and_live

declarations.type:
∃ actualFaultWeight liveUpperBound first second byzantine,
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinResilientAuthorityMedian.HonestBound actualFaultWeight liveUpperBound
      first ∧
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinResilientAuthorityMedian.HonestBound actualFaultWeight liveUpperBound
        second ∧
      liveUpperBound <
        ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinResilientAuthorityMedian.maximumOfThree first second byzantine
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinResilientAuthorityMedian.maximum_can_violate_live_upper_bound

declarations.type:
∃ actualFaultWeight liveUpperBound first second byzantine,
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinResilientAuthorityMedian.HonestBound actualFaultWeight liveUpperBound
      first ∧
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinResilientAuthorityMedian.HonestBound actualFaultWeight liveUpperBound
        second ∧
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinResilientAuthorityMedian.minimumOfThree first second byzantine <
        actualFaultWeight
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinResilientAuthorityMedian.minimum_can_violate_actual_fault_lower_bound
